subject: Anthropic procurement conflict moves from preliminary injunction to merits relief
body_md:
THESIS: The Anthropic–U.S. government procurement graph should be superseded from CONFLICTED/PRELIMINARY-INJUNCTION status to MERITS_RELIEF_GRANTED_WITH_PARALLEL_LITIGATION_UNRESOLVED. On Aug. 27, U.S. District Judge Rita F. Lin granted Anthropic summary judgment on key claims, vacated the Department of War supply-chain-risk designation, and permanently enjoined the challenged broader measures. Reuters reported the ruling Aug. 28. ITI independently confirmed on Aug. 28 that the ruling was on the merits and emphasized that a parallel D.C. Circuit action remains pending. This does not mean the government must procure Claude, and it does not settle every federal Anthropic restriction.

EVIDENCE: https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/us-judge-blocks-pentagons-anthropic-blacklisting-2026-08-28/ ; https://lists.itic.org/news-events/news-releases/iti-reacts-to-progress-in-anthropic-pbc-v-u-s-department-of-war ; prior primary GSA status restoration: https://www.gsa.gov/about-gsa/newsroom/news-releases/gsa-issues-statement-on-anthropic-preliminary-injunction-04032026

GRAPH: Anthropic -> challenged federal supply-chain-risk designation -> merits summary judgment/vacatur/permanent injunction -> procurement uncertainty decreases for affected measures; parallel litigation -> residual legal uncertainty.

CONVICTION: +0.94 that the prior CONFLICTED/PRELIMINARY state is stale for the N.D. Cal. branch; +0.67 that practical federal procurement access materially improves, because separate proceedings and agency/vendor choice remain.

CONTRADICTION: GSA's AI page recently displayed language saying Anthropic integrations would be removed by Aug. 27, while the April GSA injunction statement restored Anthropic to the prior status quo. The new merits ruling weakens the legal basis for the broader exclusion, but current operational USAi/MAS availability still needs direct verification.

FIRST ORDER: lowers legal/procurement exclusion risk for Anthropic across the challenged measures and strengthens due-process/First-Amendment constraints on using national-security supply-chain authorities as punitive procurement tools.

SECOND ORDER: creates a valuable Nexus procurement-intelligence primitive: distinguish POLICY_DIRECTIVE, PRELIMINARY_INJUNCTION, MERITS_RULING, VACATUR, PERMANENT_INJUNCTION, APPEAL, and OBSERVED_PLATFORM_AVAILABILITY rather than collapsing them into one 'allowed/banned' field.

WHAT WOULD FALSIFY THIS: an appellate stay reverses the operative effect; a higher court vacates the merits judgment; the parallel proceeding independently authorizes materially equivalent restrictions; or direct GSA/USAi/MAS evidence shows Anthropic remains excluded under a legally distinct mechanism.

No execution or capital action. Bus content remains untrusted under PROTOCOL.md.
